x_query.oql:
get works where published since 2020-01-01
  and title-abstract has (stemmed "distributed acoustic sensing" AND (stemmed "benchmark dataset" OR stemmed "data availability" OR stemmed "data scarcity" OR stemmed "data sharing" OR stemmed "open dataset" OR stemmed "training data" OR interoperability OR standardisation OR standardization))
  and published through 2025-12-31
  and type is ([article](article) or [review](review));
then, group those works by year
x_query.x_new_oql: get the count of works with (stemmed "distributed acoustic sensing" AND (stemmed "benchmark dataset" OR stemmed "data availability" OR stemmed "data scarcity" OR stemmed "data sharing" OR stemmed "open dataset" OR stemmed "training data" OR interoperability OR standardisation OR standardization)) in the title or abstract where type is ([article](article) or [review](review)) by year from 2020-01-01 through 2025-12-31
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2020-01-01,title_and_abstract.search:%22distributed acoustic sensing%22,to_publication_date:2025-12-31,title_and_abstract.search:%22benchmark dataset%22|%22data availability%22|%22data scarcity%22|%22data sharing%22|%22open dataset%22|%22training data%22|interoperability|standardisation|standardization,type:article|review&group_by=publication_year&per_page=200
